business_summary: Tibet AIM Pharm. Inc. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of medical products in China. The company's products include Miglitol tablets for diabetes; ethnic medicine products, suitable for treating breast lobular hyperplasia, uterine fibroids, and ovarian cysts; medicines for gynecology and obstetrics; and Gualoupi injection, Nalmefene hydrochloride injection, and Carbetocin injection. It also provides Domperidone tablets for treatment of indigestion, abdominal bloating, belching, nausea, vomiting, and abdominal distension and pain; Montmorillonite powder for chronic diarrhea; and Hongjin Xiaojie tablets and Aceclofenac Enteric-Coated tablets, as well as for the treatment of antibiotics, antiallergic, and digestive systems. Tibet AIM Pharm. Inc. was founded in 2003 and is based in Lhasa, China.
business_summary_ko: 티베트 AIM 제약. Inc.는 2003년에 설립되었으며 중국 라싸에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
